title: Management Accounts
description: Our Management Accounts service provides detailed, customised financial reports beyond standard statutory requirements, designed specifically for South African SMEs and growing businesses. These accounts empower decision-makers with a clear, up-to-date view of their financial health, enabling better strategic planning, performance monitoring, and identification of key trends. By transforming raw data into actionable insights, we help you make informed decisions to optimise cash flow, control costs, and drive sustainable growth for your enterprise.

title: COIDA Registration
description: COIDA (Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act) registration is crucial for any employer in South Africa to ensure their employees are covered in case of work-related injuries, illnesses, or death. Our comprehensive COIDA Registration service streamlines the entire process, from submitting the necessary documentation to obtaining your letter of good standing. This service is designed for all businesses, regardless of size, that employ one or more individuals, protecting both your business from potential liabilities and your employees with essential benefits. By registering, you fulfill a legal obligation and contribute to a safer, more secure working environment, ensuring peace of mind and compliance with South African labour laws.

title: Director Amendment
description: This service is designed for South African businesses needing to formally amend information related to their company directors, such as changes in residential addresses, appointment of new directors, resignation of existing directors, or other personal detail updates. Ensuring your company's director records are current with the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC) is crucial for legal compliance, maintaining good standing, and avoiding potential penalties. Our expert team at My Accountant handles the entire amendment process efficiently, allowing you to focus on your core business operations while we ensure all regulatory requirements are met accurately.

title: CSD Registration
description: Our CSD Registration service helps South African businesses comply with mandatory government procurement requirements. The Central Supplier Database (CSD) is a crucial online platform where all suppliers wishing to do business with any government institution – be it national, provincial, or local – must register. This registration is a prerequisite for tendering and securing contracts, ensuring transparency and efficiency in public sector procurement. By leveraging our expertise, you can navigate the complexities of the CSD system effortlessly, ensuring your business is fully compliant and positioned to bid for lucrative government contracts without delay.

title: Company Income Tax Return ITR14 (Nil)
description: Our ITR14 Company Income Tax Return (Nil) filing service is designed for South African companies registered for income tax that had no taxable income, dormant status, or no business activity during a specific tax year. Even without taxable income, SARS requires all registered companies to submit an annual ITR14 return to maintain compliance and avoid penalties. This service ensures your company fulfils its statutory obligations accurately and on time, preventing fines and safeguarding its good standing with SARS. We handle the entire submission process, providing peace of mind and freeing up your time to focus on your business.

title: NPO Registration
description: Our NPO Registration service guides you through the entire process of establishing a Non-Profit Organisation in South Africa. This service is ideal for individuals or groups looking to formalise their charitable, cultural, educational, or social welfare initiatives, enabling them to operate legally, apply for funding, and gain public trust. We handle all the necessary paperwork and submissions to ensure your organisation complies with the Department of Social Development requirements, allowing you to focus on your mission with confidence and peace of mind.
